A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Your roles:

- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- Transparent opportunities for career development.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by October 15th, 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. People with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply and will be given priority if equally qualified.

Senior Cloud Developer “SURU Connect” (f/m/d)

Are you ready to kickstart your career and take on a versatile role right from the start? To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Junior Accounting Specialist (m/f/d) at the earliest possible opportunity.

As a Senior Cloud Developer, you will design, build, and operate cloud-native applications that are core toSURU Connect and SURU SignalHub.Working across the full solution lifecycle, you will turn customer and business needs into scalable, secure, andreliable digital products. Using C#, modern .NET, Blazor and AWS, you will take technical ownership whilehelping shape architecture, engineering practices, and the future direction of SURU´s connected water andIoT platforms.

What You´ll Do:

- Design, develop, test, and applications for SURU Connect and SURU SignalHub, including APIs,background services, data-processing pipelines, and modern** Blazor **web applications
- Design reliable event-driven and distributed solutions on AWS using appropriate managed services,messaging, databases, and Infrastructure as Code. Integrate IoT devices, connectivity providers, externalplatforms, and customer systems, selecting the technologies andarchitectural patterns that best fit each usecase rather than being tied to a fixed stack
- Work closely with product, business, customers, and external partners to identify valuable use cases andtranslate them into effective technical solutions. Own solutions from initial concept and architecture throughimplementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operation
- Continuously improve reliability, scalability, security, observability, performance, and delivery automation.Contribute to architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, and knowledge sharing, while usingAI-assisted development tools and AI agents extensively for implementation, testing, debugging,documentation, quality assurance, and automatedsoftware delivery

What You´ll Bring:

- 5+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial experience with cloud-based or distributed applications
- Strong professional experience with C# and modern .NET, including ASP.NET Core, asynchronousprogramming, dependency injection, testing, and production-grade development
- Strong practical experience with Blazor and the ability to build maintainable web applications within the.NET ecosystem
- Solid understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures,asynchronous processing, and messaging-based integrations
- Practical experience designing and operating applications on AWS, including compute, storage,databases, messaging, security, and monitoring
- Strong experience with PostgreSQL, SQL, data modelling, and Entity Framework Core
- Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, containers, automated testing, observability, andproduction operations
- Ability to work across the full application stack, from backend services and integrations to Blazor-baseduser interfaces
- Ability to evaluate and adopt new cloud services, frameworks, development tools, and architecturalapproaches where they provide clear technical or business value
- Strong practical experience with AI-assisted software development and coding agents, including AI-supported quality and delivery workflows
- Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical ownership, with the ability to work proactivelywith customers, product stakeholders, and other engineering disciplines
- Proficiency in both English and German (German at least B1)

Nice to Have:

- Experience with IoT platforms, smart metering, telemetry ingestion, MQTT, connected devices, orindustrial integrations
- Experience designing highly observable and resilient distributed systems
- An AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified Developer

What´s In It For You:

- Small, agile teams where your work and voice have real impact
- Direct influence on architecture and technical direction, with ownership across the full software lifecycle
- Freedom to choose the right tools and work with modern cloud, IoT, and AI-assisted engineeringtechnologies
- Support for attending conferences and continuing your professional development

Why Join SURU?

A pipe-related water damage incident happens every 30 seconds in Germany alone. At SURU - part of LIXIL - you will build digital solutions that make water systems smarter and more reliable. SURU Connect turnssmart-metering data into useful insights, while SURU SignalHub connects devices, IoT platforms, connectivityproviders, and downstream applications. You will work across IoT, cloud infrastructure, data processing, andmodern web applications, with real influence over how our products evolve.

Are we on the same wavelength? We are looking forward to your application!
